correctness.rationale: There are exactly 80 nonempty faces (f-vector 10,30,30,10). Two independent complete face predicates coincide over all 1023 arc subsets. An explicit 38-pair partial matching on the full face poset has four critical cells of dimensions 0,2,3,3, and exhaustive topological sorting of all 80 faces/190 gradient arrows proves acyclicity. The resulting Morse CW model has cells in dimensions 0,2,3,3. The only ten 3-simplices form two disjoint full oriented simplex boundaries; these provide two independent integral H3 cycles and force both Morse three-boundary coefficients to vanish. Their attachments to the single two-sphere have degree zero and are null by pi_2(S^2)=Z. This proves the wedge equivalence with no appeal to finite homology extrapolation.

value.rationale: The five-vertex bidirected polygon is a natural earliest n=4 case in the first congruence class whose sharp connectivity is not settled by the 2026 homology theorem. The cited authors explicitly leave the wedge question open and prove non-shellability, blocking a standard shellability route. The finite certificate establishes actual attaching-map triviality and hence a homotopy type not recoverable from the reported Betti numbers, providing a useful reproducible boundary case without asserting a general theorem.
